### Rulings that bind ###
- **R1 Method (EGM `egm-drift-report`, by hand).** Take the P1 documents one at a time, in order. For each: read it and
  list the files, classes, fields, values and behaviours it names. Find them in the P2 code (grep when no path is
  given). Read the current code; do not rely on memory or on another document. Report only differences. Classes:
  `MISSING` (the document promises a feature the code lacks), `MODEL` (a field or type differs), `HARDCODED` (a fixed
  value where the document plans data or logic), `DIVERGENCE` (another pattern, library or behaviour),
  `UNDOCUMENTED` (P2 logic that no P1 document describes; report it under the document that should describe it).
  Not drift: a version or range that the documented value satisfies. An ABSENT claim states only what its command
  shows, nothing about where else the thing might be. A role or scope line that the code meets through a call into
  another lab is not drift. Each quote holds the drifting value itself (the key list, the number, the name), not a
  line that only names the topic.
- **R2 Report format.** File `repo/audit/drift/2026-11-05_DRIFT_REPORT_comlab_adr.md`. A `# ` title line, then one
  `## <path>` section per P1 document with the repo-relative path exactly as in P1 (full `labs/comlab/...` path),
  in P1 order (12 sections). A section holds `No drift detected.` or one bullet per finding, each on one line:
  `- [CLASS] <one sentence>. Doc: \`<path>:<line>\` "<quote>". Code: \`<path>:<line>\` "<quote>".`
  When the code has nothing to quote, write `Code: ABSENT (\`<command>\` -> <its output>)`. A quote is a verbatim
  span of that one line, without `"` characters.
- **R3 Read-only.** Change no document, code, test or data file. A drift is reported, never fixed; Cowork turns each
  confirmed drift into a fix row.
- **R4 Judgement.** A document that describes a plan as future work ("planned", "v2", "TODO") is not drift unless the
  code contradicts it. Doubtful cases go in the note under `Assumptions worked past`, not in the report.
